product_metadata.title: Syntus 2 Pack 100% Cotton Adjustable Bib Apron with 2 Pockets Cooking Kitchen Aprons for Women Men Chef, Black
features: Made from 100% Cotton, thicker than common polyester fiber which belongs to uniform cloth. Soft, stylish, lightweight but durable with a smooth touch. Keep you from stains.
Unique design with an adjustable neck strap for the most suitable length. Long ties that can be easily altered to fit most sizes.
2 large pockets in the middle of apron for easy holding meat thermometer, grill slips, recipe cards, etc.
Large bib apron that covers from chest to knee provides great coverage and protection from kitchen grease, spills and food stains.
Machine washable; iron able; wash with brunet cloth; bleaching, dry cleaning and tumble drying are not allowed.
